name: Tanpopo
source:
Proprietress of Asakusa Bath House (ryokan). She refers to herself using "warawa" and no one knows her age. She spends 80% of her time drinking tea with Hinata and absentmindedly photosynthesizes. She becomes embarrassed when anyone brings up the dandelion on her head.

Originally, she was sickly, but after the breakdown, she somehow became healthy and a dandelion started growing on her head. She has a mischievous side to her.

The dandelion on her head blooms and wilts according to her emotions. In fact, she is a woman with a tremendous amount of depth, love, and hate.
